title: Feature: Merge Execution History & Queue into External Tasking History
summary: Consolidate the separate Execution History and Request Queue tabs into a single unified External Tasking History tab with pagination, status/workspace/date filtering, and a pinned view for currently processing jobs.
outOfScope: Infinite scroll or load more pagination styles
Bulk actions (delete multiple jobs at once)
technicalConsiderations: Both tabs currently derive data from the same job queue storage (/workspaces/jobs/)
ExecutionHistoryTab is prop-driven; QueueTab is self-contained — new component should be self-contained
Existing detail modal pattern and usage/cost display can be reused
API endpoint needs to support pagination, filtering, and sorting parameters
Current loadExecutionHistory() server action limited to 100 items — needs pagination support
